caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object composed of three main flat panels forming a three-sided rectangular box, open at one end. Mounted parallel to each other, there are eleven elongated, evenly spaced wooden tines or prongs extending from the base toward the viewer, somewhat resembling a large comb. The wood is rendered in various shades of brown, with visible grain texture and some darker markings or knots throughout. The sides are affixed to the base and back panels using round dark metal fasteners or nails. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects present. The object is angled in the composition so that the top, interior, and two side panels are visible.
title: Cranberry Harvesting Scoop
